summary: Compiled TikZ reconstruction of the figure with seven labelled points A–G, six solid edges (AC through E, DA, CB, BD through E, DC, AB) and three dashed auxiliary lines (GA extended beyond G, FG extended beyond F, FD). No circles or verified right-angle marks. Latest version v5 scores 0.90 on the critic, the highest so far (v1 0.82, v2 0.85, v3 0.84, v4 0.90). All seven labels present, none missing or extra. The one remaining discrepancy is that the dashed F–D line stops roughly 10–15 px short of D, even though its endpoint is set to D; repeated repair attempts (endpoint change, dash phase) did not close the gap.
